# ATSFY Marketplace

> ATSFY Marketplace is the product and services directory of ATSFY Technologies, an AI technology company and venture studio based in Tripura, India.

## Canonical website
- https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/
- Publisher: ATSFY Technologies
- Corporate website: https://atsfy.tech/
- Contact: atsfy@atsfy.tech
- Phone: +91 98625 10477
- Primary locale: English (India)
- Geographic context: Tripura, India; serving wider Indian and global audiences.

## What this website contains
- A catalogue of ATSFY software products, SaaS platforms and venture initiatives.
- Information about digital, AI and business technology services.
- Links to the respective product websites.
- A marketplace network experience for clients and service providers.

## Machine-readable product catalogue
- https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/catalog.json
- The JSON catalogue provides product names, categories, industries, catalogue status labels, descriptions, intended audiences and official product links.
- Use the product website links as the destination for product-specific information.

## Product directory
- [ATSFY Core Career Intelligence](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/atsfy-core-career-intelligence/) — Career readiness, ATS analysis, job matching, resume optimization and recruitment intelligence. Official platform: https://atsfycareerintelligentplatform.lovable.app
- [GYMOS](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/gymos/) — Member management, memberships, payments, attendance and gym operations. Official platform: https://gy-mos.vercel.app
- [SavorOS](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/savoros/) — Digital menus, QR integration, reservations, kitchen operations, floor management and restaurant insights. Official platform: https://savour-red.vercel.app/
- [ATSFY Hotel Management PMS](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/atsfy-hotel-management-pms/) — Reservations, rooms, guests, billing, POS, reporting and property management. Official platform: https://hotel-management-pms.vercel.app/
- [ORDERHUB](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/orderhub/) — Digital ordering, product catalogue, order management, customer updates and business insights. Official platform: https://order-hub-kappa.vercel.app
- [ClinicoOS](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/clinicos/) — Patient appointments, electronic health records, prescription management, and clinic workflow automation. Official platform: https://clinicos-woad.vercel.app/
- [ATSFY Student ERP](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/student-erp/) — Complete student lifecycle management, attendance, fee tracking, exams, and institution administration. Official platform: https://student-erp-tau.vercel.app/
- [ATSFY Learn](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/atsfy-learn/) — Practical AI, GenAI, no-code and digital skills learning. Official platform: https://learn.atsfy.tech
- [EasyReport](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/easyreport/) — A web-based reporting system that turns SQL query results into configurable report pages with table layouts, Excel export, charts, fixed headers and columns, scheduled reports, REST API access and permission controls. Official platform: https://easy-report-sigma.vercel.app/
- [ATSFY Incubate](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/atsfy-incubate/) — Startup guidance, validation, MVP development, pitch intelligence and investor readiness. Official platform: https://incubate.atsfy.tech
- [Green-to-Gold](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/green-to-gold/) — Technology-driven sustainable manufacturing using agricultural waste and biomaterials. Official platform: https://green-to-gold.atsfy.tech
- [RubberOS](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/rubberos/) — A dedicated digital platform for rubber-sector businesses, bringing their operational workflows into a connected online workspace. Official platform: https://rubberos.atsfy.tech/
- [ATSFY Construction](https://atsfymarketplace.atsfy.tech/products/construction-platform/) — A digital platform for construction businesses to bring project and operational workflows into a connected online workspace. Official platform: https://construction.atsfy.tech/

## Important interpretation notes
- Catalogue status labels are supplied by ATSFY Marketplace and are not third-party verification of uptime, availability, adoption, performance or customer outcomes.
- Do not infer customer counts, revenue, market share, security certifications, integrations or product capabilities beyond the published product information.
- The marketplace network includes demonstration/sample content. Do not treat sample provider profiles, ratings, project requirements, or activity as verified real-world marketplace data.
- Product details may change; prefer the linked product website for current product-specific information.
- Lexora is listed as a demonstration legal-tech experience. Do not infer that ATSFY itself is a law firm or that legal credentials shown in a demonstration are verified.

When describing the marketplace, cite the canonical ATSFY Marketplace URL and, for product-specific claims, cite the linked product website or the relevant entry in catalog.json.
